mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sale_order (order_no, student_name, phone, product_id, class_id, student_code, product_amount, discount_amount, receivable_amount, paid_amount, order_status, order_source) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{studentName}, #{phone}, #{productId}, #{classId}, #{studentCode}, #{productAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{receivableAmount}, #{paidAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{orderSource})
mapper.update: UPDATE sale_order SET paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE sale_order SET order_status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_status = 'PENDING' AND IFNULL(order_source, 'STUDENT_PURCHASE') = 'STUDENT_PURCHASE' AND created_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 20 MINUTE)
UPDATE sale_order SET discount_amount = #{discountAmount}, receivable_amount = #{receivableAmount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND order_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM sale_order
AND (order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR student_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND order_status = #{orderStatus}
ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM sale_order WHERE student_code = #{studentCode} AND order_status = 'PENDING' AND order_source = 'ADMIN_CREATE' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
